dragons.name: Moondancer
dragons.description: A small, quick dragon ridden by Baela Targaryen, fierce in battle despite her modest size.

dragons.name: Vermax
dragons.description: A green dragon ridden by Prince Jacaerys Velaryon, used to rally northern houses to Rhaenyra's cause.

dragons.name: Cannibal
dragons.description: A monstrous, black wild dragon of Dragonstone known for feeding on the corpses and eggs of other dragons.

dragons.name: Dreamfyre
dragons.description: A pale blue-and-silver dragon bonded to Helaena Targaryen; one of the oldest dragons alive during the Dance.

dragons.name: Seasmoke
dragons.description: A pale silver-grey dragon first ridden by Laenor Velaryon, later claimed by the dragonseed Addam of Hull.

dragons.name: Sheepstealer
dragons.description: An ill-tempered wild dragon of the Vale who preyed on flocks, eventually claimed by the dragonseed Nettles.

dragons.name: Sunfyre
dragons.description: Said to be the most beautiful dragon ever bred, gold-scaled with pink membranes, ridden by Aegon II.

dragons.name: Silverwing
dragons.description: A swift silver-and-white dragon once ridden by Good Queen Alysanne, later claimed by the dragonseed Ulf the White.

dragons.name: Syrax
dragons.description: A golden-scaled dragon ridden by Rhaenyra Targaryen, named for a goddess of old Valyria.

dragons.name: Meleys
dragons.description: A swift, fiery scarlet dragon ridden by the elder Rhaenys Targaryen, killed alongside her at the Battle Above the Gods Eye.

dragons.name: Vermithor
dragons.description: A bronze dragon once ridden by Jaehaerys the Old King, later claimed from the wild by the dragonseed Hugh Hammer.

dragons.name: Caraxes
dragons.description: A long, serpentine, blood-red dragon ridden by Daemon Targaryen across decades of war.

dragons.name: Viserion
dragons.description: A cream-and-gold dragon belonging to Daenerys Targaryen, named for her brother Viserys; later raised as an undead wight.

dragons.name: Rhaegal
dragons.description: A green-and-bronze dragon belonging to Daenerys Targaryen, named for her brother Rhaegar.

dragons.name: Vhagar
dragons.description: Second largest dragon in Targaryen history, outliving Balerion and Meraxes to become the eldest dragon during the Dance of the Dragons.

dragons.name: Meraxes
dragons.description: Ridden by Rhaenys Targaryen during the Conquest; slain by a scorpion bolt to the eye at the siege of Storm's End.

dragons.name: Drogon
dragons.description: The largest and most aggressive of Daenerys Targaryen's three dragons, black-scaled with red markings.

dragons.name: Balerion
dragons.description: The largest dragon ever known to have lived, ridden by Aegon the Conqueror during the conquest of Westeros.
